title: Paul McCartney live: Austin City Limits Music Festival | 2018
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Austin City Limits Music Festival at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas, USA, on 12 October 2018.

It was the sixth show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019.

Paul performing @aclfestival last week ? #ThrowbackThursday #TBT pic.twitter.com/x2zwseEgeT

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 18, 2018

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

Farewell for a while USA. Last gig in Austin was a total blast! Thank you good people #FreshenUpTour pic.twitter.com/FoJu18Ouhr

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 13, 2018

McCartney had performed at Austin City Limits one week previously on 5 October 2018.
